title: Why 'most people' changes your choice
series: The invisible rules of human behavior

scenes.say: One sentence made guests reuse towels.
Researchers tested two hotel signs. One said help the environment. The other said most guests reuse their towels.
One explanation is social proof. When we're unsure, other people's choices feel like a guide to what's normal.
The most guests sign lifted towel reuse from about 35 to 44 percent.

data.title: Guests who reused towels
data.source: Goldstein, Cialdini & Griskevicius 2008, J Consumer Research
